stemMarkdown: In a 500 m race, A finishes in 32 seconds and B finishes in 48 seconds. By how many metres does A beat B? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: B's speed is $\dfrac{500}{48} = 10.4167$ m/s. When A finishes at 32 s, B has covered $10.4167 \times 32 = 333.3333$ m. A therefore beats B by $166.6667$ m.
